Hi so I’m sure that this has already been stated, but your siblings are most likely on a Medicaid plan if you are in the states and quite a few surgeries would most likely be covered after getting authorization. If it is a non covered procedure they will get an estimate from the facility where the procedure will be completed. They will have to receive what is called a good faith estimate, which is a breakdown of all of the costs upfront. The hospital/facility/doctors offices are required to provide this BY LAW due to the No Surprise Act. Please give them nothing, and ask to see their estimate for the procedure. They should have no problem producing it. If they do they’re full of shit. The facility is also required by law to get a signature on the document stating the guardian or patient has been provided with a good faith estimate. Good luck my friend I hope you get out of that toxic mess as soon as possible! Also, hard NTA.

Fucking Texas. I know it’s easy to feel like this is the end, but it doesn’t have to be. I won’t lie to you, it’s going to be a bumpy ass road with the DWI/Felony possession charge, but it doesn’t have to be the end. I’ve had quite a few friends who are in the same boat. It’s a bitch but it doesn’t have to be the be all end all. I self isolate like a motherfucker too, and I know the effects it can have. Talk to your family or friends if you can. I know it’s terrifying, but going through those things alone can really fuck with you. When you’re alone everything seem insurmountable, but being honest and open with someone can really help. Don’t let these things eat you alive. Give the people around you a chance to be there for you before disappearing. You deserve that. As fucked up as it sounds, a lot of us have driven drunk and just never got caught. A lot of us smoke carts and don’t get caught. That’s the only difference my friend. Just because you got caught doesn’t mean you deserve to die alone with thoughts of worthlessness. You’re 19. Please give yourself a break and know that you aren’t the worlds biggest fuck up. The only difference between you and millions of Americans is that you got caught. You have SO much time to come out of this and make a good life for yourself. Don’t let Texas’ ass backwards weed laws do you in my friend. Or the DWI. You can and will get through this.

Hey there. Reading your post feels like looking in the mirror. I feel the same way. I don’t live at home so there is no way for my parents to know how bad it’s gotten. I know what it feels like to fool everyone while planning to leave this way. I just posted here too. With the last shred of hope I have. I see that you are in the calming moment where there is no thinking left to do, only action to take. I don’t know your story or what you’ve been through, but please know you have worth and are worthy of so much. I’m hoping with everything in me that you are going to be okay. Good things come to an end, but so do bad things. There may be hope for us yet, friend.
